title_name: Intel Core i7 at Today's Price
hook: {count} Core i7 chips, and one of today's prices is absurd.
loop: Stay to the end, one price is absurd.

extra.narration: One last thing: K means unlocked, F means no integrated graphics, and the F is always cheaper.

takeaway.narration: Buy the F version and a graphics card, and save a little.

items.label: 12700KF
items.line: The Core i7 12700KF costs {price} and has twelve cores.

items.label: 12700K
items.line: The 12700K adds integrated graphics and costs {price}.

items.label: 13700KF
items.line: The Core i7 13700KF has sixteen cores for {price}, the best value here.

items.label: Ultra 7 265KF
items.line: The Core Ultra 7 265KF costs {price}, yet often trails older chips in games.

items.label: 14700KF
items.line: The Core i7 14700KF has twenty cores for {price}.

items.label: 14700K
items.line: The 14700K with graphics is {price}, more than the KF.

items.label: 11700KF
items.line: And the absurd one: the Core i7 11700KF costs {price} for eight old cores.

items.label: 10700K
items.line: The Core i7 10700K costs {price}, an old eight-core chip.

items.label: 9700K
items.line: The Core i7 9700K costs {price}, eight cores and no hyperthreading.
